title: Enumeration with " " value make reflection error

labels.name: reflection
labels.description: reflection of tables, columns, constraints, defaults, sequences, views, everything else

labels.name: datatypes
labels.description: things to do with database types, like VARCHAR and others

body:
If i create it with
```
ActionType = sqlalchemy.types.Enum(
    " ",
    metadata=Base.metadata, name="ActionType")
```
when i try to read them with alembic (reflection) then i get exception
